title: Mage Thunderbolt Staff Build
lede: An Elemental Staff build from level 1 to endgame. You level on the fire path, which is the only Mage build tagged for solo leveling, then respec into RaidDex's lightning Thunderbolt build for endgame. The Wavesword is your emergency weapon.

notice.title: Not verified in-game yet.
notice.text: Early Access opened on November 3, 2026. I cross-checked every Mage guide I could find and tagged each claim by how well it's supported. The trait tree below is built from Wikily's 59-node Elemental Staff list, so names, costs and connections come from there, but where the nodes sit on screen is my approximation. I searched for the real layout, but no public planner or screenshot shows it yet (as of Nov 12). A screenshot of your Staff trait screen would let me match it exactly.

stages.name: Leveling
stages.goal: Level with fire. Wall of Fire and Flaming Blossom clear packs, and Retain chains spells together.
weapons: Elemental Staff as your main weapon [ok]
skills: Flaming Blossom, Wall of Fire and Arcane Fount do your damage [one]
Retain recasts spells instantly and builds Energy Cores [ok]
Shooting Star becomes available at 10 Energy Cores [ok]
XLGAMES cut Wall of Fire's damage for launch [one]
traits: Pick "Fire leveling" in the tree below [me]
RaidDex adds Max HP and Untouchable Veil for survival [one]
gear: At Lv 40, RaidDex's spread is 64 INT / 50 CON [one]
check: Put Staff and Wavesword on Q swap
Unlock Retain and Wall of Fire
Pick up every Raeven's Coilstone you pass
Reach Shooting Star in the fire path

stages.name: Gearing
stages.goal: Get your midgame staff, then respec traits from fire to the lightning path.
weapons: XLGAMES corrected its Temper stats on Nov 10, so check current numbers before you temper it [ok]
skills: Elemental Overload: block during a Lv. 1–2 cast to cast the next tier instantly [one]
Lightning Pillar → Lightning Surge → Bolt Sequence [one]
Elemental Celerity makes you stagger-immune while casting incantations [one]
traits: Respec with Reset All in the Traits menu, then pick "Thunderbolt" in the tree [me]
Hey Jensen's Thunderstruck +12 setup needs Talent 40 [one]
gear: Light armor gives a 25% SP cost reduction, per one creator [one]

stages.name: Endgame
stages.goal: Lightning burst from range, with Shooting Star on demand and Ice Crystal as your emergency shield.
skills: Full rotation in the section below [one]
Ice Crystal (Wavesword): a shield that scales with Max HP, held on R [one]
Arcane Fount fully restores SP on Burn or Shock, once every 5 s [ok]
traits: 53 Staff and 39 Wavesword uses all 92 Early Access points [me]
gear: Put everything else into INT, with some CON as a buffer [one]
check: Cast Shooting Star at 10 Energy Cores in a boss fight

tree.intro: All 59 Elemental Staff nodes from Wikily, with their costs and requirements. The layout is approximate: rows follow Wikily's tree rows [me]. The tree has two paths: Fire leveling (53 points) and the endgame Thunderbolt path (53 points). Switch between them with the menu. The stat nodes near the top cost 5 to 10 points each, and both paths skip them.
tree.help: Click a node to read it. Double-click it, or press Space, to unlock or refund it. Fill with my points buys the selected path in order until your points run out. Your tree is saved in this browser.

presets.name: Fire leveling
presets.note: Uses the skills RaidDex's fire leveling build names: Flaming Blossom, Wall of Fire, Retain, Dual Resonance, Molten Fireball, Arcane Fount, Shooting Star, Untouchable Veil. The order is mine [me].

presets.name: Thunderbolt (endgame)
presets.note: Uses the skills RaidDex's Thunderbolt build names: Ignition, Lightning Pillar, Dual Resonance, Lightning Surge, Bolt Sequence, Elemental Overload, Lightning Spear, Shooting Star. Elemental Celerity, Lightning Speed and the rest of the order are my picks [me].

rotation.title: Thunderbolt rotation
rotation.intro: RaidDex's Thunderbolt chain [one]. Shooting Star goes on {R} once you have 10 Energy Cores.

steps.d: Three Ignitions give you about 20 s of higher crit rate.
With Lightning Speed, a Heavy Attack casts it instantly.

steps.t: Retain it with Dual Resonance, then recast
steps.d: Recasting a retained spell builds Energy Cores.
Lightning Surge follows the retained Pillar. Lightning Bolt on a Shocked target grants Bolt Sequence.
Block during the charge. Overload - Lightning Spear homes in, so you don't need to aim.
A large area strike that knocks enemies down.

rotation.after: Arcane Fount refills your SP whenever you Shock a target (once every 5 s). If something lands on you, swap to the Wavesword with {Q} and hold {R} for Ice Crystal.

split.intro: Trait points come from Raeven's Coilstones near powerful bosses [ok]. Most guides put the Early Access total at 92. RaidDex's Frost Moon page says 112, so enter the number you actually have.

disputes: RaidDex: mostly INT plus CON. Kybuza: about 2:1:1 INT / AGI / Talent. FrozenCloud: 2 stamina for each INT.
Follow RaidDex. Stats respec free, so test Kybuza's spread if you need more crit.
Nerd Bird calls it weak because casts get interrupted during ramp-up. AOEAH rates it 9/10 for PvE.
The Thunderbolt path takes Elemental Celerity for stagger immunity while casting [me].
XLGAMES cut its damage for launch. Hey Jensen still calls it "completely busted".
The fire leveling path still uses it. Endgame switches to lightning.
Most guides say 92 of 100. RaidDex's Frost Moon page says all 112 are available.
Plan for 92. Enter your real total in the tree and the planner.
